channel.title: News on BAM Engine
channel.description: Recent content in News on BAM Engine

item.title: BAM Engine 0.9.0: Results API Redesign
item.description: BAM Engine 0.9.0 redesigns the results collection API, making simulation data easier to access and explore. A follow-up patch (0.9.1) adds a log_level convenience parameter.

item.title: BAM Engine 0.8.0: Calibration Toolkit & Validation Overhaul
item.description: BAM Engine 0.8.0 extends the calibration toolkit with four new composable tools, recalibrates all validation targets from extracted book figure data, and redesigns buffer-stock validation around aggregate improvement over Growth+.

item.title: BAM Engine 0.7.0: Sequential Goods Market
item.description: BAM Engine 0.7.0 replaces the batch-sequential goods market with a pure sequential implementation, eliminating inventory collisions and delivering 6.5% faster simulations.

item.title: BAM Engine 0.6.0: Vectorized Market Matching
item.description: BAM Engine 0.6.0 consolidates two parallel market-matching implementations into a single vectorized path, delivering ~30% faster simulations.

item.title: BAM Engine 0.5.1 and the Launch of bamengine.org
item.description: We are excited to announce BAM Engine 0.5.1 and the launch of bamengine.org.
